issues.where: river channel entering the upper-left shore of the main crater lake (also visible in set-A-01-b.png)
issues.what: the river is a uniform flat teal ribbon that cuts straight into the ochre shore on a hard edge with no braided delta or carved canyon integration
issues.fix: carve the channel naturally into the slope and fan it out into a delicate braided silt delta as it meets the lake

issues.where: ochre sediment band and water surface inside the main crater lake
issues.what: the amber-ochre shore band is smooth and airbrushed, missing the intricate swirling tendrils and the hooked lower-left eddy of the target, and the dark lake interior shows faint concentric banding
issues.fix: break up the ochre shore into organic wispy swirls and eddies extending into clean, deep navy water

issues.where: upper-right rim and water of the main crater lake
issues.what: the translucent diagonal plume of mist drifting off the upper-right rim across the dark water is completely absent
issues.fix: restore a soft, wispy veil of vapour blowing diagonally from the upper-right rim over the lake

issues.where: northern inner crater rim and surrounding rocky slopes (also visible in set-A-02.png)
issues.what: lighting is harsher and cooler than the target, casting a heavy dark shadow across the upper-left inner rim onto the ochre shore and shifting the warm dusty taupe slopes to cooler blue-slate with dark black valley shadows
issues.fix: soften the directional shadows to remove the heavy dark cast on the north shore and warm the rock midtones toward dusty taupe and tan

issues.where: upper-right quadrant curving toward the rust-red plain (and the matching region in set-A-05-b.png)
issues.what: the sweeping, luminous ribbon of wispy vapour streaming from the upper-right edge down into the red plain is missing, leaving only small disconnected clouds
issues.fix: add the long, curving, translucent vapour plume sweeping from the upper-right across the red plain

issues.where: far-right plain above the large bay (and the neck region in set-A-05-b.png)
issues.what: the broad rust-red plain dotted with dark circular craters is mostly replaced by dark grey-black ridged mountains, losing both the terracotta colour and the dense crater field
issues.fix: restore the warm rust-red plain and populate it with dark, varied circular craters and basins

issues.where: coastal lowlands along the western and southern margins and lower valleys (also visible in set-A-06.png)
issues.what: broad patches of olive and moss green vegetation appear across the lowlands and coastal slopes, whereas the target is a completely barren, arid rock and volcanic landscape
issues.fix: remove the green vegetation and return the coastal lowlands to arid dusty tan, bone-grey, and rust-toned rock

issues.where: western and southern coastal shallows and interior landmass ridges
issues.what: olive-green tinting appears along the coast, shallow water shifts to bright cyan-emerald, and interior ridges show harsh charcoal-black shadows against stark white crests instead of the softer, warmer dusty-bone palette of the target
issues.fix: desaturate the emerald shallows toward deeper muted teal, remove coastal greening, and warm and soften the ridge contrast to match the target

issues.where: upper crater north of the main lake and the cluster of small dark lakes to its upper right
issues.what: the upper crater shrinks to a much smaller pool under a heavy dark shadow, and the three-lake cluster beside the main lake collapses into a single small pond
issues.fix: widen the upper basin with a softer rim and restore the multi-lobed cluster of dark basins beside the main lake

issues.where: upper-right and lower-right secondary lakes and bottom-right sea inlet
issues.what: the upper-right lake lacks the warm ochre sediment swirls, the lower-right lake is an overly smooth geometric oval, and the bottom-right sea inlet is overly bright emerald without thin cloud streaks
issues.fix: add ochre sediment trails to the upper-right lake, give the lower-right lake a more irregular shoreline, and deepen the bottom-right sea to muted navy-teal

issues.where: valleys between the upper-right mountain ribs
issues.what: only one bright orange point and a few tiny specks remain, losing the wider scatter of warm glowing volcanic vents and their soft halos on the dark plain
issues.fix: restore the small cluster of glowing orange vents with soft warm halos across the adjacent upper-right valleys
